reasoning_steps: Identify new classes based on the provided text and BFO ontology.
Ensure each class is a specific sub-type or has a unique property not covered by existing classes.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A SemiEssentialAminoAcid is a MaterialEntity that can be produced in the body but its production may not be sufficient, and it is particularly important for growing children.
classes.comment: Extends the existing ex:SemiEssentialAminoAcid class with additional properties.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A PurelyKetogenicAminoAcid is a MaterialEntity that can be used to make fat and is transformed into ketone bodies during metabolism, specifically leucine and lysine.
classes.comment: Introduces a new class for purely ketogenic amino acids.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A KetogenicAndGlucogenicAminoAcid is a MaterialEntity that can be used as both ketogenic and glucogenic during metabolism, specifically lysine, isoleucine, phenylalanine, tyrosine, and tryptophan.
classes.comment: Introduces a new class for amino acids with dual metabolic fate.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A PurelyGlucogenicAminoAcid is a MaterialEntity that can be used as a starting point for the production of glucose or glycogen and solely enters the glucogenic pathway, specifically 14 amino acids.
classes.comment: Introduces a new class for purely glucogenic amino acids.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A NonPolarAminoAcid is a MaterialEntity that has no charge on the 'R' group and is also known as hydrophobic amino acids, specifically alanine, leucine, isoleucine, valine, methionine, phenylalanine, tryptophan, and proline.
classes.comment: Introduces a new class for non-polar amino acids.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A PolarAminoAcidWithNoChargeOnRGroup is a MaterialEntity that has an uncharged 'R' group but contributes to protein structure hydrogen bonding, specifically glycine, serine, threonine, cysteine, glutamine, asparagine, and tyrosine.
classes.comment: Introduces a new class for polar amino acids with no charge on the R group.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A PolarAminoAcidWithPositiveChargeOnRGroup is a MaterialEntity that has a positive 'R' group and contributes to the basic character of amino acids, specifically lysine, arginine, and histidine.
classes.comment: Introduces a new class for polar amino acids with a positive charge on the R group.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A PolarAminoAcidWithNegativeChargeOnRGroup is a MaterialEntity that has a negative 'R' group and contributes to the acidic character of amino acids, specifically aspartic acid and glutamic acid.
classes.comment: Introduces a new class for polar amino acids with a negative charge on the R group.
